settings.hero_bio: My vision is a world where clean water and basic health care reach the people it usually forgets — and I want to spend my life building the tools that get them there. I work at the meeting point of responsible AI, hands-on engineering and community science, because the hardest problems in equity are never just technical. Whether it is a biochar filter, a one-minute vitals check or a poem, I am chasing the same question: how do we make care more honest, more equitable and more within reach?
settings.invite_body: Aadya is available to speak at student events, mentor young women entering STEM, and collaborate on water, responsible-AI and equitable-health research. Reach out to arrange a conversation.

documents.title: Autonomous Ocean pH Buoy & Chemical Buffer Dispenser

accordions.title: 3M Young Scientist Challenge Project Brief & Circuit Schematics
accordions.content: Arduino Nano microcontroller interfaced with an analog pH probe and sealed servo dispensing mechanism. When seawater acidity exceeds the predefined threshold (pH < 7.9), the servo releases micro-dosed calcium carbonate slurry to counteract localized ocean acidification.

accordions.title: Buoyancy Balance & Low-Power Telemetry Calibration
accordions.content: Next steps involve dynamic wave-buoyancy testing in coastal flumes, 5W solar trickle charging with deep-sleep power cycles, and GSM-based IoT telemetry transmitting pH logs directly to a web dashboard.

etymology.title: What "Aadya" Means to Me
etymology.content: My name is rooted in ancient Sanskrit (आद्या), meaning "The First" and "The Primordial". In Indian tradition, it represents intentional agency, calm resilience, and the quiet responsibility to act before others do. To me, it has never meant finishing first in an easy race. It means being willing to take the very first step into uncomfortable, unpaved problems—whether that's diagnosing heavy-metal contamination in agricultural runoff or stepping up to code complex odometry splines under competition pressure.

quote.text: Nothing beats kindness. It sits quietly beyond all things.
quote.author: CHARLIE MACKESY, THE BOY, THE MOLE, THE FOX AND THE HORSE
quote.reflection: In high-velocity engineering, it's dangerously easy to obsess solely over performance—PID loops, velocity constraints, or sensor parts-per-million. This quote is my compass: technical rigor is hollow if it doesn't leave people feeling treated with gentleness and dignity.
